title: History V3.6 relation-IR review artifact provenance

generatedAt.meaning: UTC time at which this review artifact was assembled.

gitCommitSha.meaning: Exact repository commit from which this artifact was generated.

gitBranch.meaning: Repository branch checked out during generation; may be empty for detached HEAD.

v36ImplementationCommitSha.meaning: Exact V3.6 relation-IR implementation commit under review. For a baseline artifact this equals gitCommitSha.

frozenV35ProductionCommitSha.meaning: Commit frozen as the V3.5 production checkpoint before V3.6 work.

frozenV35ProductionTag.meaning: Immutable tag naming the frozen V3.5 production checkpoint.

acceptedV35SemanticBaselineCommitSha.meaning: Commit accepted as the V3.5 semantic and corpus baseline; it is distinct from the later production freeze.

acceptedV35SemanticBaselineTag.meaning: Immutable tag naming the accepted V3.5 semantic baseline.

compatibility.semanticBaselineCommitSha: Not emitted in v2 review artifacts. Consumers must read the two explicit V3.5 fields. This is a breaking persisted-artifact schema change isolated by schemaVersion; no ambiguous alias is retained.
